locators.section: 2017 Festival of Japanese Culture in Salvador
locators.supports: The dissertation documents public Bon Odori participation, the eight-song cycle, Ipê Ondo and festival growth.
Bon Odori is contextualized as honoring deceased ancestors, and the Salvador festival includes an altar and public participatory dances.
